runs.question: Which four functions make up the NIST AI RMF Core, and which one is described as cross-cutting?

answer.text:
The NIST AI RMF Core is made up of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. Part 2 comprises the "Core" of the Framework. It describes four specific functions to help organizations address the risks of AI systems in practice. GOVERN is the function described as cross-cutting. It is meant to be infused throughout the other three functions.

The MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions can be applied in AI system-specific contexts and at specific stages of the AI lifecycle, while GOVERN covers all stages of an organization's AI risk management processes.

Source: NIST AI 100-1, AI RMF 1.0 (January 2023), pages 8 and 25.
